name: Colavita Aged Balsamic Vinegar of Modena (Mellow Sweet)
whyItWorks: Aged in wooden casks, resulting in a rich, syrupy reduction of cooked grape must with lower harsh acetic bite than raw distilled white vinegar. Certified low-FODMAP at 1 tbsp servings.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar with 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil and a pinch of fine sea salt for a gut-safe salad or roasted veggie drizzle.
